name: Pheasant
siboNotes: Naturally FODMAP-free protein that's well-tolerated during SIBO treatment phases. Choose plain preparations without high-FODMAP seasonings.
preparationTips: Season with low-FODMAP herbs like rosemary, thyme, or oregano
Avoid marinades containing garlic or onion - use garlic oil instead
Cook thoroughly to 165°F internal temperature due to game meat safety
Pair with low-FODMAP vegetables to create balanced meals
nutritionalHighlights: High in lean protein (25-30g per serving)
Rich in iron and B vitamins
Lower in fat than many domesticated poultry
Good source of phosphorus and selenium
